product.title: Kyoto Custom Highlight: Private Walking Tour with Licensed Guide

description.text: In Kyoto, this private walking outing lets the group pick a four-hour or eight-hour window and two to four published stops instead of a scripted coach loop. The listed options include Kinkaku-ji, Fushimi Inari-taisha Shrine, Nijo Castle, Gion, Kiyomizu-dera Temple, Nishiki Market, Tenryu-ji Temple, and the Kyoto Imperial Palace, with Philosopher's Walk and Pontocho as pass-bys. Hotel meetup is included; entrance fees and transport fares stay separate. Public transportation or taxis may be used between sites. The format suits first-time visitors who want a licensed walk without booking three district tours separately. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Kyoto, and the itinerary stays on Kinkaku-ji, Fushimi Inari, and Nijo Castle that shape this outing rather than a Nara day.

start.description: Meet the licensed guide at the confirmed Kyoto hotel meeting point listed when booking. Public transportation or local taxis may be used between sites.

end.description: Return to your Kyoto meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
